field_checks.summary: Primary XML/PDF and final activity records were independently enumerated: 24 activity rows, 9 toxicity rows, and 6 documented exclusions. Fig. 3, Fig. 4b/c, Fig. 6, and Table S1 values are represented as exact text/figure/table values or controlled qualitative/nonconvertible exclusions; no row-level required field issue was found by script.

All 12 DBAASP fallback rows were reviewed as machine candidates only. The authoritative match report and linked article/assay/sequence/literature snapshots contain zero linked authoritative rows, so all 12 final record audits correctly remain unresolved_record, zero are source_verified, and authoritative DBAASP/RC2/portal ingest is false.

Every current paper-final JSON and packet-final mirror was parsed and reviewed. Paper and packet mirrors are byte-identical for activity, database, materials, mechanism ontology, and review report; packet mechanism_evidence.json is also byte-identical to the mechanism ontology mirror. Counts agree: 24 activity, 9 toxicity, 12 database audits, 6 mechanism claims, 0 review rework targets. Latest strict acceptance gates passed with zero hard findings and live open ticket count is 0.

The six mechanism claims preserve evidence strength: 2 direct mechanism claims limited to SEM morphology and NPN permeability, 3 inferred claims, and 1 phenotype-supported claim. No CPFx DNA-gyrase/esterase-release proposal, charge argument, ROS mention, or MIC phenotype is promoted to a direct mechanism without direct assay support.

Paper identity was verified from primary XML/PDF as RSC Advances 2025, DOI 10.1039/d5ra02932e, PMCID PMC12153049, PMID 40503297. Entities 1, 2, CPFx-1, and CPFx-2 are source-linked to synthesis/characterization and activity surfaces; no authoritative database row is linked, which is preserved as a database caution rather than promoted identity evidence.

All final activity/toxicity rows have endpoint, value or controlled no-value rationale, unit or controlled no-unit rationale, target, assay conditions, source locator, approximation status, and normalization status. Units are preserved as reported; graph-only/qualitative rows are not converted. A recursive script found zero objects containing both a plain one-letter sequence and sequence_length, so there are no residue-count mismatches to repair.

Recursive/fallback authority is not asserted. Final review and database artifacts keep authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready false, machine_fallback_rows_promoted_to_authoritative false, and fallback rows excluded from RC2/portal/authoritative ingest. Latest strict acceptance confirms paper-level acceptance only and zero open rework tickets.

Three nonblocking cautions remain and are preserved rather than smoothed: no authoritative linked database rows, fallback rows candidate-only, and approximate/excluded supplementary graph values. The Fig. 4c CPFx-2 S. aureus MIC rounding conflict is explicitly retained as 3.13 μM from the figure label versus 3.125 μM in XML text.

The single staged supplementary PDF is readable and was inspected across all 19 pages. Supplement surfaces S1-S19 include methods, Table S1, qualitative Fig. S13, and quantitative Fig. S14-S17 surfaces; supplementary_tables.json carries Table S1 plus five figure surfaces and 160 quantitative figure observations. archive_manifest.json records no archives, and extraction_status is material_extracted_complete with zero errors.

Toxicity/selectivity coverage includes BEAS-2B viability >90% at 50 μM for CPFx-2, LDH release surface, murine hemolysis, body-weight monitoring for local/systemic administration, and organ H&E. Graph-only surfaces are not converted into unsupported exact values and are represented with approximate/nonconvertible status plus source-surface coverage.

cautions.summary: The paper is publication-grade for source-reviewed paper evidence but not authoritative DBAASP/RC2/portal ingest-ready: linked authoritative article, assay, sequence, and literature row counts are all zero, and the 12 fallback rows remain unresolved_record candidate evidence.

Some source surfaces are graph-only or qualitative. The final preserves them as approximate/nonconvertible or documented exclusions, and explicitly preserves the CPFx-2 S. aureus MIC figure/text rounding conflict rather than silently normalizing it.

The final review_report still contains nested planned/pending postresponse gate wording, but the later strict acceptance artifact and live packet ticket state show the gates were rerun, return codes are zero, hard findings are zero, and open tickets are zero.
